messages.author: f885e974e72cf61d
messages.subject: 'tree must be of class 'phylo.'' error
parts:
Hi geomorph community,

I'm wondering if any of you could provide some insight regarding a "tree must be of class 'phylo.'" error message. I'm attempting to analyze phylogenetic signal in my data, and according to the structure of the tree, its class is "phylo" before and after sorting the data to match the tree. Please advise on the best course of action; it would be greatly appreciated! Code provided below: 



###Import phylogenetic tree in Nexus format

> must.tree = read.nexus ("MustelidTreeLaw2018.nexus")
> plot.phylo (must.tree) 
> str(must.tree) 
List of 5
 $ edge       : int [1:34, 1:2] 19 20 21 22 23 24 25 26 27 27 ...
 $ edge.length: num [1:34] 17.8 15.5 14.8 14 12 ...
 $ Nnode      : int 17
 $ root.edge  : num 28.8
 $ tip.label  : chr [1:18] "Lontra_longicaudis" "Lontra_canadensis" "Aonyx_cinerea" "Aonyx_capensis" ...
 - attr(*, "class")= chr "phylo"
 - attr(*, "order")= chr "cladewise"

###Sort data to match tree

> tree.data = treedata(must.tree, species.means.2d, sort=TRUE)
> shape.data.3d = arrayspecs(tree.data$data, 264, 3)
> must.tree.matched = tree.data$phy
> str(must.tree.matched) #double check tree attributes
List of 5
 $ edge       : int [1:34, 1:2] 19 20 21 22 23 24 25 26 27 27 ...
 $ edge.length: num [1:34] 17.8 15.5 14.8 14 12 ...
 $ Nnode      : int 17
 $ root.edge  : num 28.8
 $ tip.label  : chr [1:18] "Lontra_longicaudis" "Lontra_canadensis" "Aonyx_cinerea" "Aonyx_capensis" ...
 - attr(*, "class")= chr "phylo"
 - attr(*, "order")= chr "cladewise"

###Phylogenetic signal in species brain shape

> species.ps = physignal(must.tree.matched, species.means, iter = 10000, seed = NULL, print.progress = TRUE)
Error in physignal(must.tree.matched, species.means, iter = 10000, seed = NULL,  : 
  tree must be of class 'phylo.'




All the best,
Ani

Ani Hristova
Master’s Candidate
Department of Integrative Biology
Ecology, Evolutionary Biology, and Behavior Program
Michigan State University

messages.author: fbfd20ce829c6c6c
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] 'tree must be of class 'phylo.'' error
parts:
Ani,

By just looking at the code, it seems you switched the order of the data and the tree, as per the physignal help file. "physignal(A, phy, iter = 999...)", where A is the data, and phy is the phylogeny.
If the arguments are not specified, they must be entered in the same order as in the documentation.

The following lines of code are equivalent and should both work and give the same result.
species.ps = physignal(species.means, must.tree.matched, iter = 10000, seed = NULL, print.progress = TRUE)
species.ps = physignal(phy = must.tree.matched, A = species.means, iter = 10000, seed = NULL, print.progress = TRUE)

You can also leave out arguments if you do not change the default to get the same answer as the 2 lines above.
species.ps = physignal(species.means, must.tree.matched, iter = 10000)

Hope that works for you!
Bryan
